messages:
Harper (CSM): Kicking off Asterion onboarding. Primary 30d goals: secure API integration, SSO cutover, baseline p95 < 300ms for core flows, and a product acceptance pass >= 90% on the labeled set. Who are owners on your side?
Nora (Asterion PM): Nora here. I'll own product acceptance and rollout. Ibrahim is infra. Add metric: reduce user search failure rate by >= 12% during pilot.
Ibrahim (Asterion Infra): Ibrahim Infra lead. Our IdP OIDC metadata: https://sso.asterion.net/. We need Redwood outbound IPs and a 2-hour maintenance window for DNS switch. Available: Sat 03/09 01:00-03:00 UTC.
Liam (Solutions Eng): Liam here. Proposed schedule: week1 connector + SSO smoke, week2 E2E bench + relevance tuning, week3 acceptance + enablement. I'll provision a sandbox and share ephemeral creds. Please provide labeled eval (50-200 examples) by day 7.
Harper (CSM): I'll send allowlist and schedule three workshops: Tech deep-dive, Prompt tuning lab, and Support handoff. Also creating a 5-question weekly feedback survey for pilot users.
ProvisionBot: sandbox deployed: asterion-pilot-sbx v1 at 2839990065 (creds pending)
Liam (Solutions Eng): Deploy noted. Question: start with KV/prefix caching ON or OFF? I recommend OFF for first 14 days to surface raw model behavior.
Nora (Asterion PM): Agree caching OFF initially. Also request per-route cost tags in logs so we can map spend to features.
Harper (CSM): Action items: Harper->send allowlist + survey; Liam->post curl examples + sandbox keys; Nora->deliver labeled eval + acceptance doc; Ibrahim->confirm OIDC metadata + maintenance window. Renewal note: if active pilot traffic < 25% of target by day 21 escalate to AM for steering call.
Liam (Solutions Eng): Quick curl example I'll add to the shared doc:
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ASTERION_SBX" -d '{"input":"Summarize invoice #42"}' https://sbx.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Nora (Asterion PM): We'll provide labeled set (100 examples) by EOD Thu. Recording of enablement please, and upload to our docs.
Harper (CSM): Perfect. I'll follow up with calendar invites and the acceptance criteria doc link in this thread. Check-in scheduled for day7 bench results. :thumbsup:
